title: Defense tech, AI, and fundraising take center stage at StrictlyVC Los Angeles on June 18
description: With just two weeks to go, StrictlyVC Los Angeles is quickly approaching. On Thursday, June 18, at The Aerospace Corporation Campus in El Segundo, investors, founders, and tech leaders will gather for an evening of conversation exploring some of the most consequential shifts taking place across venture capital, defense technology, artificial intelligence, and advanced industry. Secure your spot here. […]
summary_cn: StrictlyVC洛杉矶大会将于6月18日在美国埃尔塞贡多的航空航天公司园区举行，汇聚投资者、创始人和科技领袖。会议重点探讨国防科技（Defense Tech）与AI的融合趋势，以及当前环境下的融资策略。对于AI产品经理而言，这意味着国防领域对AI产品的需求增加，如自主系统、威胁检测和决策辅助等；同时投资者更关注能服务政府/国防客户的AI初创公司，产品需要强调安全性与合规性。该活动反映了AI应用从消费互联网向国家安全领域的生态延伸。
